writeup.title: fix(stock): prevent race conditions and release holds on failed payments
writeup.summary: This branch fixes a stock race condition by replacing the separate check-and-update steps with a single conditional UPDATE statement. It also ensures that failed or timed-out payments immediately release their stock holds rather than waiting for them to expire.
changes: Replaced separate read and write inventory checks with a single conditional UPDATE via try_reserve to prevent race conditions during concurrent checkouts.
Added release_order_holds to instantly release stock holds when an order payment fails or experiences a gateway error.
Updated existing tests and metrics expectations to reflect immediate stock release on failed payments.

functions.what_it_does: Mark the order failed and save the payment attempt.
Hold units in one conditional UPDATE; False if there is not enough stock.
Hold stock for every line of an order, or raise OutOfStock.
Give back all of an order's held stock (skipped under the leak fault).

writeup.release_note: Fixed stock race conditions during high concurrency and made failed payments release stock holds immediately instead of waiting for TTL expiration.
